analyticalQuestion: What is company-wide capex intensity where annual revenue and capex are compatible?
comparabilityRequirements: No layer-wide or market-wide financial totals.
Annual and interim observations are not mixed.
Missing and withheld values remain unavailable, not zero.
Company-wide financial observations are not AI-specific allocations.
limitationText: This is company-wide capex intensity, not an AI-specific capital-spending allocation.
metricDefinition: Company-wide capex divided by company-wide revenue for the same entity, fiscal year, period end, unit, and currency.
